limits: No coefficient, polynomial, matrix, recurrence or inequality-gap was recomputed; saved numerical witnesses and failure counts remain retained observations.
Zero-triangle counts use count-based degree d=wordlength+truecount-1 and match recorded totals; this is not a new computation of each raw polynomial's degree or support.
Grouped/cone counts use index endpoints supplied by retained support/conjugacy identities; no new positivity/LC calculation was performed.

Initial raw-prefix enumeration uses supported dictionary centers; zero/scope versions include the degree triangle plus one zero boundary layer and all three directions. None filters by polygon guards.
Ascending denominator traversal means each completed source word is first encountered as complete; deduplication does not hide a completed-word failure in the recorded scope assertion.
Truncated zeros count appearances in overlapping tested triples, not distinct zero coefficient positions. Only H is tested at prefixes; F and H are tested at completed inputs.
Raw-cone and grouped probes use auxiliary mixed predicates; reported failures are not root failures. Their finite no-failure predicates are not universal proofs.
